child.introduction: Robin is a fictional learner created to demonstrate a portfolio. This sample connects classroom observations, descriptive reflections and practical next steps. 本档案仅使用虚构资料，展示观察、教师反思与家庭活动如何关联。

evidence.title: Learning invitation 1 / 学习活动
evidence.description: Robin selected two materials, tried a different arrangement and shared an idea with a peer. This record describes the moment without inferring a fixed trait. Robin选择了两种材料，尝试另一种排列，并与同伴分享想法。
evidence.teacherNote: Next, offer another opportunity in a different context and record what changes. 下一次在不同情境中再次观察，并记录支持方式。
